text: ほのおの　じゃくてんは　エイチ　ツー　オー　と　いわれてる

structure.jp: ほのおの　じゃくてんは
エイチ　ツー　オー　と　いわれてる

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: エイチ　ツー　オー　と　いわれてる
patterns.explanation: と comes right after the thing that is said. エイチ　ツー　オー　と　いわれてる = 'it is said to be H2O'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: いう becomes いわれる to mean 'is said' by people in general, rather than someone saying it. いわれてる = 'is said'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: てる is the short spoken form of ている, showing this is what people keep saying. いわれてる = 'is said (generally)'.
